content_sections.heading: About KVASU
content_sections.text: Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (KVASU) is a university in Kerala. This vacancy is at the university's Meat Technology Unit at Mannuthy, Thrissur District, Kerala - 680651. The post is funded under the unit's revolving fund project.

content_sections.heading: KVASU Assistant Production Manager Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy is earmarked for the Open category under the rotation of reservation. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: KVASU Assistant Production Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: B.VSc&AH Registration with the Veterinary Council of India M.VSc in Livestock Products Technology or Veterinary Public Health Experience in related job roles Only candidates who meet the essential qualification may attend the walk-in interview. Before attending, check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Certificate verification at the Meat Technology Unit, Mannuthy, from 09.30 AM on 10 November 2026. Walk-in interview on the same day for candidates found eligible at the verification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on contract. The selected candidate must sign an agreement stating "no claim for the arising permanent posts in the University". The person appointed will have no claim to a regular appointment in the University. Failing to maintain discipline or to perform the assigned duties makes the employee liable to immediate termination. The employee may leave the job by giving one month's notice. The Head of the Institution may end the appointment at any time during its period without giving a reason. Hiding facts or canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification, or to termination even after appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVASU Assistant Production Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the format appended to the notification. Arrange self-attested copies of all your documents in the order listed in the application form. Number the pages and bind the set neatly. Report for certificate verification at 09.30 AM on 10 November 2026 at the Meat Technology Unit, Mannuthy - 680651, Thrissur Dist., Kerala. Hand in the filled application form at the time of the interview, and attend the walk-in interview after the verification. CV Self-attested copies of all relevant documents: testimonials, certificates and publications Proof of age and community Experience certificates in relevant fields The originals of all these documents for verification Copies brought without their originals will be summarily rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which category is the KVASU Assistant Production Manager vacancy reserved for?
faq.answer: The single vacancy is earmarked for the Open category under the rotation of reservation.

faq.question: Q2. What time should I reach the venue on 10 November 2026?
faq.answer: Report by 09.30 AM for certificate verification at the Meat Technology Unit, Mannuthy - 680651. Eligible candidates then attend the interview on the same day.

faq.question: Q3. Is a master's degree required?
faq.answer: No. An M.VSc in Livestock Products Technology or Veterinary Public Health is only desirable. The essential qualification is B.VSc&AH with Veterinary Council of India registration.

faq.question: Q4. Which project is the post under?
faq.answer: The post comes under the revolving fund project at the Meat Technology Unit, Mannuthy.

faq.question: Q5. How should I arrange my documents?
faq.answer: Bind the self-attested copies neatly in the order listed in the application form, number the pages, and bring the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q6. Will KVASU pay travel expenses for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to applicants for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Can the selected candidate later claim a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. The selected candidate must sign an agreement of "no claim for the arising permanent posts in the University". The appointment is purely on contract.

faq.question: Q8. How much notice must I give if I want to leave the job?
faq.answer: The employee may leave the assignment by giving one month's notice.
